open_points.subject: Project and Customer initial last-changed instant
open_points.text: “A Project and a Customer — the records that carry a revision — carry the instant they were created and the instant they were last changed” states both facts, but only says when the last-changed instant moves after creation; it does not state its initial value for a newly created Project, a newly recorded Customer, or a Customer created by import.
open_points.question: What last-changed instant does a Project or Customer receive when its record is first created?
options: Set it to the same instant as the created/recorded instant.
Record a separate initial last-changed instant for the creation transaction.
Leave it absent until the first later change.
open_points.default_guess: Set it to the same instant as the created or recorded instant.

open_points.subject: ArtifactPointer when its project is deleted whole
open_points.text: M05 says a pointer is “Durable, a record of its own naming its project” and explicitly says it is “kept after anonymisation,” while M01 allows “archived -> deleted whole” and M03 explicitly says its records go when the project is deleted. No text says whether the project's separately stored artifact pointers go when the project is deleted whole.
open_points.question: What happens to every ArtifactPointer naming a Project when the owner deletes that Project whole?
options: Delete all of those pointers with the Project.
Retain the pointers even though their Project no longer exists and they are no longer reachable through project reads.
Retain pointer tombstones with a changed or removed project relationship.
open_points.default_guess: Delete all ArtifactPointers naming the Project as part of deleting the Project whole.
